verdict.rationale: Expensify documents SmartScan photo capture: tap the camera and it extracts merchant, date, total and currency in realtime. Community users confirm receipt scanning extracts amounts well. However, HN reports say SmartScan relied on MTurk human transcription and that processing took around 20 minutes in one case, which raises doubts about the realtime OCR claim. Missing for 10: email-forwarding capture is not evidenced, automatic matching of a receipt to the right card transaction is not documented, and there is no independent confirmation of realtime automated OCR.
